items.title: The biggest questions behind the $100 billion Venezuelan oil bet by the US
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Washington Correspondent Ben Werschkul joins Market Domination host Josh Lipton to report on the US-Venezuela oil deal that will require $100 billion in capital investments and whether the partner company, North American Blue Energy Partners, is ready to ramp up its oil production.

items.title: Chevron's big bet: Why its $7B Venezuelan oil investment makes sense
items.summary: Chevron (CVX) will invest $7 billion in Venezuela over the next five years to double its crude oil (CL=F, BZ=F) production there. This comes just days after the US entered a major oil deal with Venezuela, buying up a large portion of the country's oil production rights. Morning Brief host Julie Hyman discusses the details with Politico senior reporter Sam Sutton and Semafor business reporter Rohan Goswami.

items.title: US energy firms dominate Venezuela deals worth billions
items.summary: US energy firms on Wednesday signed a raft of multibillion-dollar deals with Venezuela, days after the South American country agreed to grant the United States control of a huge chunk of its vast oil reserves.Energy Secretary Chris Wright traveled to Caracas to oversee the signing of deals worth "tens of billions of dollars of investment," seen as a quid pro quo for Washington winning majority control of 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil reserves.

items.title: Eni Becomes Operator of 35-Billion-Barrel Venezuelan Oil Field
items.summary: Italy’s Eni has signed a 25-year contract with Venezuela’s state oil company PDVSA that makes the Italian energy major the exclusive operator of the giant Junín-5 heavy-oil field in the Orinoco Belt.

items.title: Chevron, Eni Lead Wave of Deals to Lift Venezuela Oil Output
items.summary: Executives from Chevron Corp., GE Vernova Inc. and Eni SpA joined US Energy Secretary Chris Wright and acting Venezuelan President Delcy Rodríguez to unveil a wave of energy deals aimed at boosting crude production in the South American nation.

items.title: Chevron Just Committed $7 Billion to Venezuela. Here's What It Means for CVX Stock.
items.summary: Chevron just doubled down on Venezuela right after Washington cut an oil deal there. Will this bet pay off?

items.title: Chevron Bets $7 Billion on Venezuela Oil Expansion
items.summary: Chevron plans to invest more than $7 billion in Venezuela over five years, aiming to more than double its oil output to about 600,000 bpd.
